race.description: The Club Beaudesert Classic Mdn Plate
race.comment: SHE LOVES ME (6) boasts the best recent staying form, finishing second over 2190m at Ipswich, while holding a strong market position. The new 2450m is a challenge, but she has three placings from five starts this prep, and benefits from McColm's claim. SILVERTAIL (7) has unimpressive finishing positions but looks suited by the rise in trip on the short turnaround. CONCADOR (2) has placed fourth at Ipswich in his last two runs and faces an easier task than his latest race, but SHE LOVES ME bested him three weeks ago, and he's unproven at 2450m. JIEBA (3) drops from CL1, draws the inside, and wears blinkers for the first time. He needs to improve from his Ballina finish, but his Coffs Harbour run offers some hope. CHAYSE 'N' RALPH (1) best of the rest.
